adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` fetch with `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately call methods on the result (`save_host(host)` which does `host.host = ...`, and `host.destroy`). If the id is stale/invalid, `host` will be `nil`, causing a `NoMethodError` (500) instead of a not-found response. Additionally, `save_host` directly accesses `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` / `[:category_id]`, which will also raise if `params[:embeddable_host]` is missing from the payload.
